newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish central bank lends 25 trln lira at 80 pct.
newsitem.headline: Turkish central bank lends 25 trln lira at 80 pct.

text.p: 1500 GMT - Turkish central bank funded banks 25 trln lira o/n at 80 pct at close after draining 29.3 trln lira via 5-day reverse repo auction at 79.10 pct avg in morning. * Lira ended easier at 99,350 per dollar vs Tuesday's 99,325, despite banks' dollar sales and lower dollar/mark parity. * Longer maturity T-bill, bond yields firmed after sharp rate rise at Tuesday's 182-day bill auction and higher o/n money rates.
